mapper.sql: settlement_id, order_id, refund_id, seller_id, buyer_id, tenant_id, gross_amount, commission_amount, net_amount, status, done_at, hold_until, settled_at, channel, channel_trans_no, fail_count, create_time, update_time
NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trade_refund r WHERE r.order_id = s.order_id AND r.status IN ('pending_seller','seller_agreed','buyer_returned','refunding','mediation'))
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO settlement_order (order_id, seller_id, buyer_id, tenant_id, gross_amount, commission_amount, net_amount, status, channel, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{sellerId}, #{buyerId}, #{tenantId}, #{grossAmount}, #{commissionAmount}, #{netAmount}, #{status}, #{channel}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT s.settlement_id, s.order_id, s.seller_id, s.tenant_id FROM settlement_order s JOIN trade_order o ON o.order_id = s.order_id JOIN seller_account a ON a.seller_id = s.seller_id AND a.tenant_id = s.tenant_id WHERE s.status = 'holding' AND o.status = 'done' AND o.done_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE_ADD(o.done_at, INTERVAL #{holdDays} DAY) <= NOW() AND a.kyc_status = 'verified' AND ORDER BY s.settlement_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_order s JOIN trade_order o ON o.order_id = s.order_id SET s.status = 'pending_settle', s.done_at = o.done_at, s.hold_until = DATE_ADD(o.done_at, INTERVAL #{holdDays} DAY), s.update_time = NOW() WHERE s.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND s.status = 'holding' AND o.status = 'done' AND o.done_at IS NOT NULL AND
mapper.select: SELECT s.settlement_id, s.order_id, s.seller_id, s.tenant_id, s.net_amount, s.channel FROM settlement_order s JOIN seller_account a ON a.seller_id = s.seller_id AND a.tenant_id = s.tenant_id WHERE s.status = 'pending_settle' AND a.kyc_status = 'verified' AND a.frozen = 0 AND s.fail_count < #{maxFailCount} ORDER BY s.settlement_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_order SET status = 'settled', settled_at = NOW(), channel = #{channel}, channel_trans_no = #{channelTransNo}, update_time = NOW() WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND status = 'pending_settle'
UPDATE settlement_order SET status = 'closed', refund_id = #{refundId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status IN ('holding','pending_settle')
UPDATE settlement_order SET status = 'clawback', refund_id = #{refundId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND status IN ('settled','withdrawn')
UPDATE settlement_order SET fail_count = fail_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId}
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.seller_id AS sellerId, o.tenant_id AS tenantId, p.pay_amount AS channelAmount FROM trade_order o JOIN trade_pay p ON p.order_id = o.order_id AND p.status = 'paid' AND p.biz_type = 'trade' AND p.pay_user_id = o.buyer_id AND p.tenant_id = o.tenant_id LEFT JOIN settlement_order s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE s.settlement_id IS NULL AND DATE(o.paid_at) = #{bizDate} LIMIT 1000

SELECT s.settlement_id AS settlementId, s.order_id AS orderId, s.seller_id AS sellerId, s.tenant_id AS tenantId, s.gross_amount AS platformAmount FROM settlement_order s LEFT JOIN trade_pay p ON p.order_id = s.order_id AND p.status = 'paid' AND p.biz_type = 'trade' AND p.pay_user_id = s.buyer_id AND p.tenant_id = s.tenant_id WHERE p.pay_id IS NULL AND DATE(s.create_time) = #{bizDate} LIMIT 1000

SELECT s.settlement_id AS settlementId, s.order_id AS orderId, s.seller_id AS sellerId, s.tenant_id AS tenantId, s.gross_amount AS platformAmount, p.pay_amount AS channelAmount FROM settlement_order s JOIN trade_pay p ON p.order_id = s.order_id AND p.status = 'paid' AND p.biz_type = 'trade' AND p.pay_user_id = s.buyer_id AND p.tenant_id = s.tenant_id WHERE s.gross_amount <> p.pay_amount AND DATE(s.create_time) = #{bizDate} LIMIT 1000

SELECT r.refund_id AS refundId, r.order_id AS orderId, s.settlement_id AS settlementId, s.seller_id AS sellerId, s.tenant_id AS tenantId, s.status AS settlementStatus FROM trade_refund r JOIN settlement_order s ON s.order_id = r.order_id WHERE r.status = 'refund_success' AND s.status NOT IN ('closed','clawback') AND DATE(r.update_time) = #{bizDate} LIMIT 1000

SELECT order_id AS orderId, COUNT(*) AS cnt, MIN(tenant_id) AS tenantId, MIN(seller_id) AS sellerId FROM settlement_order WHERE DATE(create_time) = #{bizDate} GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 1000
